scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs && echo Packages are installed.
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs api && npm run dev --prefix services/api
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs web && npm run dev --prefix apps/web
scripts.make-admin: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs api && npm run make-admin --prefix services/api --
scripts.doctor: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs api && npm run doctor --prefix services/api
scripts.set-password: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs api && npm run set-password --prefix services/api --
scripts.test-email: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs api && npm run test-email --prefix services/api --
